block_node.block_desc:
Simulate accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer sensors.
The block outputs sensor measurements based on device motion. The inputs are in the local navigation frame. The outputs are in the local sensor body frame. The parameters on the Accelerometer, Gyroscope and Magnetometer tabs can be set to match values on a sensor datasheet.

Inertial navigation system and GNSS/GPS simulation model.
The block outputs noise corrupted versions of the input position, velocity, and orientation. Specify additional kinematics to simulate noise-corrupted acceleration and angular velocity. Simulate GNSS loss by specifying a position error factor.
Vary the Roll, Pitch, Yaw, Position and Velocity accuracies to change the noise levels present in the output signals. Accuracy is defined as the standard deviation of the noise.
The Position and Velocity input ports should be N-by-3 vectors. The Orientation input port should be an N-by-4 quaternion array, a 3-by-3-by-N array of rotation matrices, or an N-by-3 array of Euler angles in degrees.

Simulate a GPS Sensor.
The block outputs noise-corrupted GPS measurements based on the input position and velocity in the local coordinated frame or geodetic frame. The block uses WGS84 earth model to convert local coordinates to latitude-longitude-altitude coordinates.
To change the noise levels present in the system, vary the horizontal position, vertical position, and velocity accuracies. Accuracy is the standard deviation of the noise. Specify the decay factor as a scalar in the range [0,1]. To model the global position with white noise, set decay factor to 0. For random walk noise, set decay factor to 1.
The Position and Velocity input ports are N-by-3 matrices. The LLA and Velocity output ports are N-by-3 matrices. The Groundspeed and Course are N-by-1 vectors. Course angle is measured in degrees.
